cards.title: For parents staring down the barrel of six weeks' childcare: take a tip from orangutans
cards.body: With school summer holidays upon us, parents face the challenge of arranging affordable, memory-making fun for six weeks. Scientists say that messing about and playdates have health benefits for humans of all ages, just as orangutans arrange them for their offspring.

cards.title: Amid the social and political panic about falling birthrates, why not ask new mothers what they think?
cards.body: New research reveals deep anxieties among new mothers about having children. Rather than offering medals and cash bonuses as incentives, policy should address women's real concerns and priorities.

cards.title: My family is coming apart – so it's time for one last video game session
cards.body: A father reflects on 20 years of family life as his household of five prepares for a major change. He attempts to create one last perfect family games night together.

cards.title: The Fastest Way to Calm a Reactive Child
cards.body: When parents calmly explain rules repeatedly, children's nervous systems may hear something entirely different. Understanding how a child's nervous system responds is key to effective communication.

cards.title: Brothers, Sisters, and Divorce: What Happens Between the Kids
cards.body: Sibling relationships are often the longest relationships people have in life. Divorce can either strengthen these bonds or fracture them depending on how families navigate the experience.

cards.title: Why Is the Mother-Daughter Relationship so Tricky?
cards.body: Mother-daughter dynamics can be complex and challenging for both parties. Understanding these dynamics may help ease tension and improve the relationship.

cards.title: Why We Keep Returning to Early Coldplay
cards.body: Parenting often involves understanding what resonates with your children's emotional lives. Albums like Parachutes resonate because of their uncertainty and longing, qualities many young people experience.

cards.title: There's a reason child vaccination rates are falling
cards.body: Child immunisation rates are falling across the UK, prompting clinics to take aggressive steps to boost vaccination rates. Understanding the real reasons behind declining rates is crucial for public health.

cards.title: Fathers and Children: The Beginning of a New Conversation
cards.body: Sometimes the most healing words between fathers and children are not spoken but heard. When fathers listen without explaining themselves, old wounds begin to soften and hope emerges.
